reviewItem.question: Does "Removed the `default` section of the runtime overrides config file: This was introduced in 2.9 and likely not widely used" mean a change to config-key:loki|path=default|component=runtime-config (removed)?

proposed.statement: The `default` block of the runtime overrides config file (added in 2.9) was removed; set default values in the top-level `operational_config` of the standard Loki config instead.
